For example, see https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto "No one shall be subjected to arbitrary arrest, detention or exile. Everyone is entitled in full equality to a fair and public hearing by an independent and impartial tribunal, in the determination of his rights and obligations and of any criminal charge against him. No one shall be subjected to arbitrary interference with his privacy, family, home or correspondence, nor to attacks upon his honour and reputation. Everyone has the right to the protection of the law against such interference or attacks." Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50137303 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

item.title: Show HN: Esp32sim - Run ESP32 firmware in the browser (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hi HN, I've been working on esp32sim, an open-source ESP32 emulator that runs in the browser. The fun part of the demo is that there is no ESP32 involved - the firmware is executing in the emulator. The goal is to make ESP32 software easier to experiment with, test and simulate without always needing physical hardware connected. Source: https://github.com/mikroverk/esp32sim I made a short video showing it in action: https://youtu.be/waoWFilTWEc I'm particularly interested in feedback from embedded developers: what would an emulator like this need to support before you'd actually use it for development, testing or CI? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50131189 Points: 135 # Comments: 13
